rows.text: Raises full year 2026 revenue guidance to $2.97 billion to $2.99 billion and adjusted net income guidance to $21.28 to $21.48 per diluted share

• For the fourth quarter of 2026, the Company expects revenue in the range of $760 million to $780 million and adjusted net income in the range of $193 million to $200 million, or $5.67 to $5.87 per diluted share.

• For the full year 2026, the Company now expects revenue in the range of $2.97 billion to $2.99 billion and adjusted net income in the range of $736 million to $743 million, or $21.28 to $21.48 per diluted share, compared to previous guidance for revenue of $2.86 billion to $2.90 billion and adjusted net income of $689 million to $703 million, or $19.68 to $20.08 per diluted share.
